changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingchargeresponsibility AS SELECT bcr.id, bcr.charge_id, bcr.charge_line_id, bcr.patient_service_product_id, bcr.patient_id, bcr.encounter_id, bcr.responsible_party_type, bcr.responsibility_role, bcr.payer_id, bcr.patient_insurance_id, bcr.policy_number, bcr.member_number, bcr.responsibility_amount, bcr.allocated_amount, bcr.outstanding_amount, bcr.coverage_percentage, bcr.deductible_amount, bcr.copay_amount, bcr.coinsurance_amount, bcr.non_covered_amount, bcr.contractual_adjustment_amount, bcr.currency, bcr.status, bcr.pre_authorization_required, bcr.pre_authorization_status, bcr.pre_authorization_reference_no, bcr.claim_id, bcr.claim_reference, bcr.superseded_responsibility_id, bcr.adjustment_reason, bcr.effective_date, bcr.closed_date, bcr.idempotency_key, bcr.created_by, bcr.created_date, bcr.last_modified_by, bcr.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_charge_responsibility bcr;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingchargeresponsibility TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbillingchargeresponsibility FROM report_user;
